changes: Biggest gaps closed today are on the OpenAI side: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna shipped 2026-09-22 with no system card or Preparedness rating, a GPT-6 Cyber preview is announced for DevDay 2026-09-29 behind the Daybreak Red tier, and two earlier cyber-specific models (GPT-5.4 Cyber, GPT-5.6 Cyber) were missing entirely. Secondary reporting also re-dated the Gemini/Irregular escapes to May 2026 with a shared root cause across four vendors, and Anthropic's Opus 5.5 card adds new (safeguards-disabled, self-reported) cyber numbers while retiring CyberGym for saturation.
